syllabus: N4 is planned as 10 units of 10 points; this is unit 1 (ability and change): 可能形, 〜ことができる, 〜ようになる, 〜なくなる, 〜ようにする, 〜ようにしている, 〜ように (purpose), 〜ために, 〜やすい, 〜にくい. Is this a fair N4 set, and is the order sensible?
style: Only the N5 and N4 kanji (about 290) are written in kanji; every other word is in kana (じゅうしょ, こうえん, よてい). In teach and drill text only words with an N4-only kanji carry a reading (運動 with うんどう above; 毎日 bare). Exam-style text has no readings. Does this match what an N4 learner should see?

Exam-style items, week-test items, the scene check, reading passages and listening choices have spaces between phrases, as the N4 paper does (わたしは　まだ　漢字が　あまり（　　）。). Teach and drill text has no spaces. Is this the right split?
Right answers are spread over positions 1 to 4, as on the real paper; options were reordered after writing. Is that fine, or does any option list read in an odd order?

n4u01d1.p1: Watch note says the thing you can do 'usually takes が' (漢字が書けます). Fair, given 漢字を書ける is also heard?
n4u01d1.d1: Non-words are used as wrong options in this unit (読められます, 読みられます, 食べけません, 運く, 持りました, 主所). Fine? Also please confirm 読まれます (passive) is clearly wrong here.
n4u01d1.d2: Answer 食べられません. Wrong option 食べさせません is the causative (unit 8). Clearly wrong with なっとうが, and fair before it is taught?
n4u01d1.d3: Answer 借りることができます. The reason says 借りるのができます 'is not said'. Clearly wrong to a native?
n4u01d2.d1: Answer する (運動するようになりました). Is した clearly wrong here?
n4u01d2.d6: Star item: tiles end 行かなく, with なりました outside. Natural split, and is 小さい犬のそばにも行かなく the only order?
n4u01d2.e2: Answer 読めなく　なりました. 読まなく　なりました is wrong only because of 小さい　字が. Clearly wrong to a native?
n4u01d2.k: Scene is a progress chart at a language school. 教室 fits it weakly. Fine as the eighth word?
n4u01d2.r1: Passage opens 四月から　むすこの　ノートを　書いて　います (a mother's notebook about her son). Clear and natural?
n4u01d3.d4: Answer ようにしています. B starts with はい. Is ようにします ('I will from now') clearly wrong as the reply?
n4u01d3.e2: On the ようにする day the answer is ように　なりました. Fair, and are ように　します, ように　して　ください, ように　しましょう clearly wrong?
n4u01d3.e3: Rewritten after the check (テレビを見る時間を短くするようにしています). Please read once.
n4u01d3.k: Level: スマホ (drill d2) and ねむれる (listening); both come back on day 6. Fine at N4?
n4u01d3.r1: Question これから　何を　する　ように　しますか. 夜　早く　ねる is something she already does. Clearly wrong, or does the question leave room?
n4u01d4.p2: Watch note: ために follows an action you choose; 見える takes ように. Fair as a rule, given 上手になるために is natural?
n4u01d4.d1: Answer ように. Is ので clearly wrong (聞こえないので、小さいこえで話しました)?
n4u01d4.r1: Passage and an option use 集中できる (N3?); passage also has 三十分以上. Fine at N4, or replace 集中?
n4u01d5.d4: Answer 読みにくくないですよ after いいえ. Natural, or would a native say 読みやすいですよ? Is やすくない clearly wrong?
n4u01d5.d6: Star item: このペンは重くて字が書きにくいです. Natural without a comma, and is 字が重くて… clearly wrong?
n4u01d5.k: Level: 新品, 品切れ, 送料 (scene) and いかがですか (listening). Fine at N4?
n4u01d6.c1: Option ように is called wrong because nothing follows it. Clearly wrong, given 〜ように can end a sentence as a wish?
n4u01d6.d2: Answer ために (働くために). ことができる and ようになる fail only because they cannot join the clauses. Is ように clearly wrong after 働く?
n4u01d6.d4: Answer ようにしてください (B's advice after じゃあ). Are ようになりました, ために, ことができます clearly wrong?
n4u01d6.d5: Star item with ように twice (読めるように毎日漢字を書くようにしています). Natural, or too heavy?
n4u01d6.e1: Answer ように. Is 電話が　できるために clearly wrong to a native?
n4u01d6.k: Level: 説明会, 自動車学校 (scene). Fine at N4?
n4u01t.6: Answer 発音. Are 漢字 and 試験 clearly wrong (日本語の（　　）を　よく　したい)?
n4u01t.12: Answer ように　して　います. Is ように　します clearly wrong as B's reason for being healthy?
n4u01t.13: Answer ように. Is ので clearly wrong (かぜを　ひかないので、手を　あらって　います)?
n4u01t.21: Answer 自分で　料理を　作るように　なってから. The only defensible answer?
